subject: Request: HelpfulHealth pilot - temporary uptime guardrail & commercial offset
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara@helpfulhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, procurement@helpfulhealth.com
Cc: HelpfulHealth Finance <finance@helpfulhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot SLA ask — HelpfulHealth x Redwood

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. We want to move forward with a 90-day pilot but have one ask from procurement and finance: given our expected bursty traffic and the pilot nature, we need a temporary relaxation of the uptime SLO from 99.95% to 99.5% and a cap on any service credit exposure. In exchange, HelpfulHealth can commit to an initial three-month prepaid credit and a short-term volume commitment.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a provisional uptime guardrail and what commercial offset (discount/credit) you would need to accept reduced remedies? Procurement would like the commercial terms documented in the SOW.

Attachments: HelpfulHealth_requirements_summary.pdf (attached)

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement hopes to get to legal by next week.

Best,
Sara
CTO, HelpfulHealth

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara@helpfulhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot SLA ask — HelpfulHealth x Redwood

Sara — thanks for the clarity and for moving fast. We can support a provisional uptime guardrail for a bounded pilot but it requires Deal Desk / commercial signoff because it changes our standard remedies.

High level proposal from my side:
- Temporary uptime target: 99.5% for 90 days (pilot window)
- Cap on service credit exposure: $10k for the pilot period
- Commercial offset: 15% prepaid credit applied against pilot invoices OR a one-time onboarding discount (either works for us)
- Legal/Proc: SOW to call out the pilot duration, measurement windows, and an explicit cap on credits

I need to escalate this to Marissa and Ben for exec commercial approval — copying them. I will push for a decision within 48 hours so procurement can start legal review.

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara@helpfulhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot SLA ask — HelpfulHealth x Redwood — request for exec approval

Marissa / Ben — forwarding HelpfulHealth's request. Key points below:
- HelpfulHealth wants 90-day pilot; asking to relax uptime SLO to 99.5% (from our usual 99.95%)
- They want a cap on service credits; procurement prefers fixed cap in SOW
- They will do a 3-month prepaid credit and a short volume commitment in exchange

Attachments: HelpfulHealth_SOW_v1.pdf, pilot-latency-snapshot-may2027.png

Ask: can Deal Desk approve a provisional SLO change + commercial offset (we discussed around 15-20% in the call)? If approved, I'd like to lock terms: 99.5% for 90 days, $10k max credit liability, 15% prepaid discount. Also confirm whether Legal needs specific clause language — I can draft.

Minimal customer risk: pilot, limited duration, prepaid money up front. This is a high-probability expansion opportunity in healthcare.

Thanks — Tessa

On Wed, May 5, 2027 at 08:32 AM Tessa Morgan wrote:
> (See forwarded message)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara@helpfulhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SLA ask — HelpfulHealth x Redwood — request for exec approval

Tessa — thanks for the summary. After reviewing the ask and the revenue upside, I am willing to approve a constrained exception with the following conditions:

1) Temporary uptime target set to 99.5% for exactly 90 days starting on the pilot start date stated in the SOW.
2) Maximum aggregated service credit exposure limited to $10,000 for the pilot period.
3) Commercial offset: HelpfulHealth must prepay three months of pilot usage and accept a 15% onboarding discount applied to that prepay. No additional consumption discounts during the pilot.
4) Legal to include an explicit clause: "Pilot remedies are limited and non-precedential; full standard SLOs resume at production conversion."
5) Deal Desk/Finance to confirm accounting treatment of the prepaid credit; Ben, please confirm you can authorize the invoice terms.

If Ben and Legal sign off, this is approved. Tessa, please route the SOW and draft clause to Legal and Finance and loop me in on the DocuSign envelope.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara@helpfulhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SLA ask — HelpfulHealth x Redwood — request for exec approval

All — finance confirms we can accept the prepaid structure and apply a 15% onboarding credit against the initial invoice. We'll treat the prepay as deferred revenue per standard accounting; cap on credits acknowledged. Legal should add Marissa's non-precedential language.

Marissa — you have our sign-off to proceed. Tessa — please send the SOW with the updated remedy clause and I will authorize the invoice terms.

Thanks — Ben

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara@helpfulhealth.com>, procurement@helpfulhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: HelpfulHealth pilot — provisional uptime guardrail & commercial offset

Sara — good news, Deal Desk and Finance have approved the constrained exception. Agreed terms below (to be reflected in SOW):
- Pilot duration: 90 days
- Temporary uptime SLO: 99.5% for pilot window
- Maximum service credit exposure: $10,000 for the pilot period
- Commercial offset: 15% onboarding credit applied to three-month prepaid invoice
- Clause: Pilot remedies are limited and non-precedential; production SLOs will revert on conversion

Next steps: I will update the SOW and include the clause Marissa requested, attach the updated SOW to the DocuSign envelope (link below), and route to you for signature. Please confirm pilot start date (we recommend May 12) so we can lock measurement windows.

DocuSign (will be sent): https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Sign?envelopeId=abc-123-helpful

Thanks everyone — excited to get this pilot moving.

Tessa Morgan
